lines.en: label yumidorm25:
I knock on Yumi’s dorm and wait to see if she’ll answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的宿舍门，等着看她会不会应。

lines.en: I haven’t stopped by her room since the incident with her mother, so I’m not really sure if she’s feeling embarrassed or down about it.
lines.zh: 自从她母亲那件事之后，我就没再来过她的房间，所以我不太确定她现在是觉得丢脸，还是因此消沉。

lines.en: : Yeah? What do you want?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你想怎样？

lines.en: : It’s me.
lines.zh: : 是我。

lines.en: : I know who it is, numnuts. You knock louder than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我知道是你，蠢蛋。你敲门比谁都响。

lines.en: : Well, can I come in?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能进来吗？

lines.en: : Now? No. I’m trying to sleep.
lines.zh: : 现在？不行。我要睡觉。

lines.en: : But your light is on. I can see it through the bottom of the door.
lines.zh: : 可你的灯还亮着。我从门缝底下能看见。

lines.en: To be honest, no I can’t. But Yumi doesn’t know that, so I’m calling her bluff.
lines.zh: 说实话，我看不见。但 Yumi 不知道，所以我在诈她。

lines.en: : Stop peeking into my room, you creep! What if I like sleeping with the light on?! Is that a fucking problem?
lines.zh: : 别偷看我的房间，你这变态！万一我就喜欢开着灯睡呢？！这有什么他妈的问题吗？

lines.en: : Yumi, just let me in. I don’t want to stand out here all night.
lines.zh: : Yumi，让我进去就行。我可不想在外面站一整晚。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god. Fine.
lines.zh: : 哦我操你的上帝。行吧。

lines.en: : Just come in. The door is open.
lines.zh: : 进来吧。门开着。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into Yumi’s dorm, kicking over a plastic bag of empty water bottles she’d placed directly in front of the door for some reason.
lines.zh: 我走进 Yumi 的宿舍，一脚踢翻了她不知为何正对着门口放着的一塑料袋空水瓶。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive1
: You know you’re picking those up, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你得把它们捡起来吧？

lines.en: : Of course I do...
lines.zh: : 我当然知道……

lines.en: Not being an absolute heathen, I begin to pick up the bottles that have since gone rolling across the floor...even if it’s Yumi’s fault that I knocked them over in the first place.
lines.zh: 作为一个还算有教养的人，我开始把滚了一地的瓶子捡起来……尽管一开始是我踢翻的，而 Yumi 把袋子放在那儿也有错。

lines.en: : Did you actually try cleaning your half of the room for once?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真的终于打扫了你那一半房间吧？

lines.en: : So what if I did? I’ve gotta make more fucking room somehow.
lines.zh: : 打扫了又怎样？我总得他妈腾出更多地方啊。

lines.en: : It might be worth not putting your garbage directly in front of the door next time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过下次也许别把垃圾直接放在门前面比较好。

lines.en: : It might be worth checking your surroundings before you come waltzing in like you own the place.
lines.zh: : 也许你下次进来之前也该先看看周围，别跟这儿是你家似的横冲直撞。

lines.en: : That aside, how are things?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，最近怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive2
: Oh, please tell me you didn’t come all the way here just to ask me how my day went.
lines.zh: : 哦，别告诉我你大老远跑来就为了问我今天过得怎么样。

lines.en: : It was shit, just like every other day. Thanks for asking. Now leave.
lines.zh: : 糟透了，跟每一天一样。多谢关心。现在你可以走了。

lines.en: : I’m not leaving yet. There’s something I’ve been wanting to talk to you about, and I didn’t really get a chance when we went to the ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 我还不走。有件事我一直想跟你谈，上次去拉面店的时候没机会说。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive3
: And have you considered if I actually want to talk about that?
lines.zh: : 那你有没有考虑过，我到底想不想谈那个？

lines.en: : If it's about my mom, I’m pretty sure that I made it very clear I want nothing to do with her when I stormed out of the place.
lines.zh: : 如果是关于我妈，我想我冲出那家店的时候已经说得很清楚了——我不想跟她有任何关系。

lines.en: : But hey, the job hunt needs to continue now I guess...So you can keep pretending you care about me for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 不过行吧，看来找工作的事还得继续……所以你可以再假装关心我一阵子。

lines.en: I finish picking up the bottles and toss the bag next to the door- not in front of it like an absolute monster.
lines.zh: 我把瓶子捡完，把袋子放到门边——而不是像某个彻头彻尾的怪物那样，放在门前。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not going to force you to talk about anything. But I do think it might be good for you if you got some of it off your chest.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不会逼你谈任何事。但我确实觉得，把一些话吐出来对你会好一点。

lines.en: : Does Chika know about your situation at least?
lines.zh: : 至少 Chika 知道你的情况吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive4
: Of course she knows. She’s my best friend.
lines.zh: : 她当然知道。她是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : You’re just some dude trying to get into my pants. And you can’t make that stupid skirt joke again because I actually am wearing pants this time.
lines.zh: : 你只是个想上我的家伙。而且这次你没法再开那个裙子蠢玩笑了，因为我这次真的穿的是裤子。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I’m pretty sure the only time I’ve ever seen you smile is when I made that joke.
lines.zh: : 要是我没记错的话，我好像只见过你笑过一次——就是我开那个玩笑的时候。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive5
: I told you to never fucking mention that again!
lines.zh: : 我说了别他妈再提那件事！

lines.en: : You brought it up. I’m just trying to add to the conversation.
lines.zh: : 是你先提起的。我只是想给对话加点料。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive6
: If you want to add to the conversation, bring up something that actually matters.
lines.zh: : 你想给对话加点料，就提点真正重要的东西。

lines.en: : You mean like your mom?
lines.zh: : 你是说比如你妈？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive5
: No! Not like my fucking mom!
lines.zh: : 不！不是我他妈的妈！

lines.en: : And another thing! Why the fuck do you know her? How does that even happen?
lines.zh: : 还有一件事！你他妈为什么会认识她？这到底是怎么发生的？

lines.en: : The day that you and I were supposed to have dinner at the ramen shop, she came out of the bathroom and tried consoling me.
lines.zh: : 就在你和我本来约好在拉面店吃晚饭那天，她从洗手间出来，试着安慰我。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she thinks we’re dating.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她以为我们在谈恋爱。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive7
: Why the fuck would she think that?! That’s disgusting!
lines.zh: : 她为什么会他妈那么想？！太恶心了！

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she also accused me of, and these are not my words- putting it in the wrong hole.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她还指控过我——这可不是我的原话——插错了洞。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive8
: Okay, time to leave. Get the fuck out and please never say another word to me ever again.
lines.zh: : 好了，你可以走了。给我滚出去，求你这辈子都别再跟我说一个字。

lines.en: Yumi tries to push me out of the room, but suddenly stops when I say this-
lines.zh: Yumi 试图把我推出房间，但听到我接下来说的话，她突然停住了——

lines.en: : She talked about you, too, you know.
lines.zh: : 她也谈到你了，你知道的。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive9
: Can’t imagine it was anything good.
lines.zh: : 我想也不是什么好话。

lines.en: : I don’t even remember the last time I saw her.
lines.zh: : 我甚至都不记得上次见她是什么时候了。

lines.en: : She ran out a long fuckin’ time ago. Real shit mom, if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 她很早以前就跑了。真是个该死的好妈妈，是吧。

lines.en: : Well, she didn’t say anything bad at least...
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少她没说什么坏话……

lines.en: Though, to be honest, I can’t remember her saying anything good either.
lines.zh: 不过说实话，我也不记得她说过什么好话。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure our talk was about something like kids just wanting to do their own thing at the end of the day, which is abundantly true in Yumi’s case.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定我们聊的大概是「孩子到头来只想做自己的事」之类的话题——放在 Yumi 身上，这一点简直再明显不过。

lines.en: : Of course she doesn't have anything bad to say. She barely ever saw me.
lines.zh: : 她当然没什么坏话可说。她几乎没怎么见过我。

lines.en: : Surprised she even remembers my face.
lines.zh: : 她居然还记得我长什么样，我都觉得意外。

lines.en: : Like you said, you two have the same eyes.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，你们俩有一双一样的眼睛。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive10
: You literally didn’t even notice that until I pointed it out.
lines.zh: : 我指出来之前，你根本他妈没注意到。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I said they were your words. I’m just trying to figure out what’s going on between you two.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我说那是你的话。我只是想搞明白你们俩之间到底怎么回事。

lines.en: : Nothing, obviously.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有，很明显。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive11
: And now the one fuckin’ place I probably had an actual shot at turned me away.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我大概唯一真有点机会的那个地方，也把我拒之门外了。

lines.en: : Did you use the noodle strategy?
lines.zh: : 你用了面条策略吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive5
: Yes! I used the stupid fucking noodle strategy!
lines.zh: : 用了！我用了那个该死的面条策略！

lines.en: : And it actually worked until my fucking MOM walked in with my TEACHER!
lines.zh: : 而且它本来真的管用，直到我他妈的妈跟我的老师一起走了进来！

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive10
: Least I don’t have to worry about you fucking her since she’d kick your ass if you ever tried to pull that shit.
lines.zh: : 至少我不用担心你会去操她——你要是敢那么干，她会把你打得满地找牙。

lines.en: : Yeah, she probably would. I won’t deny that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她大概会。这点我不否认。

lines.en: : She’s a rather...intimidating woman.
lines.zh: : 她是个相当……有压迫感的女人。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive11
: Yeah, being a Yakuza-wife will do that to you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，当过黑道老婆的人就是会这样。

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive12
Yumi sighs heavily and moves to her bed, resigning herself to the fact that this is going to be a thing that we talk about.
lines.zh: Yumi 重重地叹了口气，挪到床边，认命地接受了「这件事我们非谈不可」这个事实。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Don’t act like you don’t fucking know.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。别装得好像你他妈不知道似的。

lines.en: : I really don’t, though. Don’t the Yakuza dress a little less...spiky?
lines.zh: : 可我是真不知道。难道黑道的人穿得不那么……刺儿一点吗？

lines.en: : She seemed like more a biker-gang sort of girl.
lines.zh: : 她看起来更像是飞车党的那种人。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive13
: Well since you’re so fucking curious about my mom all of a sudden, how about I give you a little rundown of her life?
lines.zh: : 行啊，既然你突然对我妈这么他妈好奇，那我就给你简单讲讲她这辈子？

lines.en: : She dropped out of [high_school], joined a biker gang, met my dad, had me, left both of us, and now she apparently likes ramen.
lines.zh: : 她从[high_school]辍学，加入飞车党，认识了我爸，生了我，然后把我们俩都甩了，现在看来她喜欢拉面。

lines.en: : The end. That’s the life of my mom.
lines.zh: : 完。这就是我妈的一生。

lines.en: : Oh, and also, throw a few years of drug abuse into the mix as well. Really great role model.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，再往里掺上几年吸毒。真是个了不起的榜样。

lines.en: Suddenly, Yumi’s attitude begins to make a little more sense.
lines.zh: 突然之间，Yumi 的态度变得好理解了一些。

lines.en: I always knew there was something going on in the background with her but...I didn’t realize how intense it was.
lines.zh: 我一直知道她背后有什么隐情，可……我没意识到有那么严重。

lines.en: : Any fucking questions?
lines.zh: : 还有什么他妈的问题吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Was it hard?
lines.zh: : 难熬吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive14
: Which part?! The one where my mom left me or the one where my dad is in the Yakuza?!
lines.zh: : 哪一部分？！是我妈抛下我那部分，还是我爸在黑道那部分？！

lines.en: : Actually, don’t even answer that! Because the answer is obviously yes!
lines.zh: : 算了，你别回答了！因为答案显然是难熬！

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive15
: And you know what the craziest part is? I’d be fucking fine if I decided to follow in either of their footsteps.
lines.zh: : 你知道最疯的是什么吗？要是我决定走他们俩任何一个的老路，我他妈反而会好过。

lines.en: : Sure, there’d be a chance of me gettin’ addicted to crack or cocaine or whatever the fuck she was doing when I was growing up, but at least I’d have a place to belong.
lines.zh: : 当然，我可能会染上快克或者可卡因什么的毒瘾——管她在我长大的那些年里搞的是什么——可至少我会有个归属。

lines.en: : But nope. All I do is sell TVs and crash at my friend’s place, freeloading off of her because I don’t know what else there is to fuckin’ do in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 但没有。我做的全部事情就是卖电视，蹭在我朋友家，靠她养着，因为我不知道在 Kumon-mi 还有他妈什么别的事可做。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive16
: And like...why the fuck am I even telling you any of this? Not like you can do anything to change it.
lines.zh: : 而且……我他妈到底为什么要跟你说这些？反正你也改变不了什么。

lines.en: : Just the bullshit circumstances I was born into.
lines.zh: : 不过是些我出生就带着的狗屁境遇罢了。

lines.en: : It’s probably because you want to vent.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你想发泄吧。

lines.en: : Probably. I just...never thought I’d fucking see her again.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我只是……从没想过我他妈还能再见到她。

lines.en: : But I guess it makes sense that I did.
lines.zh: : 不过见到了，倒也说得通。

lines.en: : Someone like her has no way of escaping a place like this.
lines.zh: : 像她那种人，是没法从这种地方逃出去的。

lines.en: : Technically, no one has a way of escaping a place like this.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，谁都没法从这种地方逃出去。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive17
: Yeah, but that’s a new thing. I meant before.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那是最近才有的事。我说的是以前。

lines.en: : When she ran out, she could have gone fucking anywhere.
lines.zh: : 她跑掉的时候，本来可以去他妈的任何地方。

lines.en: : But no. She’s still here.
lines.zh: : 可没有。她还在那儿。

lines.en: : There’s something about this fucking city that just sucks people in and never lets them out.
lines.zh: : 这座该死的城市有某种东西，把人吸进去就再也不吐出来。

lines.en: : And if there’s anything I got from her, it’s the fact that I’ve also just decided it’s okay to be caught in the vortex.
lines.zh: : 而如果说有什么是我从她身上继承来的，那就是——我也已经认定，被困在漩涡里也没关系。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive18
: Oh good, and now I’m about to cry. Knew this would happen as soon as I started ranting.
lines.zh: : 哦好极了，我快哭了。我就知道一开始发牢骚就会这样。

lines.en: : Go ahead and cry if you want.
lines.zh: : 想哭就哭吧。

lines.en: : I’m the only one here right now. I’m not going to tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 现在这儿只有我一个人。我不会告诉任何人的。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive19
: Stop fucking being nice to me! It doesn’t help!
lines.zh: : 别他妈对我这么好！没用的！

lines.en: : Call me a fucking bitch or something!
lines.zh: : 骂我一句婊子什么的！

lines.en: : Tell me I’m a kid and I need to fucking get over it!
lines.zh: : 告诉我是个小孩，让我他妈看开点！

lines.en: : That is the shit that helps! Not all this fake-ass compassion that you’ve conveniently decided to save for the moments when I feel like complete garbage.
lines.zh: : 那种话才有用！不是你现在特意留到我觉得自己像坨垃圾的时候，才拿出来的这套假慈悲。

lines.en: Part of me wants to do exactly what she’s telling me to.
lines.zh: 我有一部分，很想照她说的做。

lines.en: The truth is that she is just a kid and that this is something she needs to get over.
lines.zh: 事实上，她确实只是个孩子，而这确实是她需要跨过去的东西。

lines.en: There’s no time to cry over things like family or the circumstances we grew up with.
lines.zh: 没有时间为家庭、为成长的境遇去哭。

lines.en: Doing that will just hold us back.
lines.zh: 那么做只会拖住我们。

lines.en: But something about seeing cute girls cry just makes me want to destroy protect them.
lines.zh: 可不知道为什么，看到可爱的女孩哭，只会让我想毁掉她们、保护她们。

lines.en: And I need to ravage be nice to her or I might wind up seeing her break right in front of my eyes.
lines.zh: 而我得去蹂躏她、对她好一点，否则我可能会眼睁睁看着她在我面前崩溃。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive20
: God fucking damnit. Say something at least so I don’t feel like a fucking moron sitting here talking to myself.
lines.zh: : 天杀的。你至少说句话，别让我像个傻子一样坐在这儿自言自语。

lines.en: : How about we just talk about the next step in the Yumi Revitalization Project instead?
lines.zh: : 我们要不直接聊聊「Yumi 复兴计划」的下一步吧？

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive21
: So what?...You’re just going to ignore the fact that I was crying in front of you?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？……你就打算假装我刚才在你面前哭过这件事不存在？

lines.en: : Were you? I didn’t even notice.
lines.zh: : 你哭了吗？我都没注意到。

lines.en: : Oh, please. You don’t have to pretend you didn’t see it.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。你不用装作没看见。

lines.en: : See what? I really don’t have any idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 看见什么？我真不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : We had a conversation about your mom. I found out about how shitty your background is. And then we started brainstorming ways to fix it.
lines.zh: : 我们聊了聊你妈。我了解到你的出身有多糟糕。然后我们开始想办法解决它。

lines.en: : That’s all that happened here tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚发生的就这些。

lines.en: scene yumidormtwofive22
: Oh. Uhh...
: Cool.
lines.zh: : 挺好。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 谢什么？

lines.en: : For letting me rant and...not rubbing my weakness in my face.
lines.zh: : 谢你让我发牢骚，还……没把我的软弱摔在我脸上。

lines.en: : It literally kills me inside to say this, but I respect that.
lines.zh: : 说这句话简直要了我的命，但我尊重这一点。

lines.en: : Even if you’re a spineless pig.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你是个没骨头的猪。

lines.en: : Why do you always have to ruin the sweetest moments between us by insulting me?
lines.zh: : 为什么你每次都要靠骂我，来毁掉我们之间最甜的时刻？

lines.en: : Why do you have to be so fucking...insultable?
lines.zh: : 为什么你他妈总是那么……好骂？

lines.en: : Fair point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : Let’s just figure out our next course of action and...save your family issues for another time.
lines.zh: : 那我们就想想下一步怎么办，把你的家庭问题……留到下次再说。

lines.en: : Or never. Preferably never.
lines.zh: : 或者永远别再提。最好永远别提。

lines.en: : The further I am from them, the better.
lines.zh: : 我离他们越远越好。

lines.en: : Gotta...carve out my own path or whatever other inspirational bullshit normal teachers tell their students.
lines.zh: : 得……开辟自己的路，或者随便别的正常老师会跟学生说的那种励志狗屁。

lines.en: : Yeah. Those definitely wouldn’t be my words.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那绝对不会是我的措辞。

lines.en: : Mine would be a lot more controversial.
lines.zh: : 我的说法会更有争议一些。

lines.en: : And mildly sexual.

lines.en: scene black
Despite our best efforts, Yumi and I aren’t really able to think of anything.
lines.zh: 尽管我们都很努力，Yumi 和我也真想不出什么来。

lines.en: Instead, we go for a walk to the convenience store and I wind up buying her a few cups of instant noodles that she can ration throughout the week.
lines.zh: 于是我们去了趟便利店，我给她买了几杯泡面，够她撑过这一周。

lines.en: Or whenever she wants.
lines.zh: 或者她想什么时候吃就什么时候吃。

lines.en: Frankly, it doesn’t matter to me.
lines.zh: 说实话，我无所谓。

lines.en: We split apart on the way back to the dorm and go our separate ways.
lines.zh: 回宿舍的路上我们分开了，各走各的。

lines.en: The entire walk home, I can’t help but try to wrap my head around Yumi’s situation.
lines.zh: 回家的整段路上，我都在试图理清 Yumi 的处境。

lines.en: As horrible as it may be, it still doesn’t excuse the way she acts, though.
lines.zh: 尽管那处境糟透了，它依然不能成为她那种态度的借口。

lines.en: But it at least helps me understand it.
lines.zh: 但至少，它帮我理解了。

lines.en: At the end of the day, I’m just glad I was finally able to learn something about her.
lines.zh: 说到底，我很高兴我终于了解到了一些关于她的事。
